shared_elements: incised border line following the arched top
a framed panel/register within the arched field
justification: Both are round-topped stelae with an incised border echoing the arch and an inset framed field, which is a shared format rather than shared imagery. Beyond that the depicted content diverges completely: A shows a large lattice/net-like grid over a curved band with rounded lumps and a central vertical shaft, while B shows a figural lunette (human figures raising arms toward a rayed disc) above many dense rows of small sign-script, none of which appears in A.
